info.description: Versioned REST API for Nucleum. Authenticate with a personal access token as a Bearer token. Lists page with cursors, writes accept an Idempotency-Key, and errors are RFC 9457 problem details.
info.title: Nucleum API

get.description: Collections and types of the app's records. Requires nucleum:read. Pages are ordered by `sort` and continue with `cursor`. Archived records are left out unless `isArchived=true` is given, which lists the records that are archived themselves.

post.description: Requires nucleum:write. Repeating the request with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body does not write again: it answers with the record's current state and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. A key belongs to the token's account, this operation and the record it targets, and is remembered for 24 hours (a create key keeps naming the record it created). Sending it again with another body gets a 422 problem with code `idempotency_key_reused`; an update sent again while the first is still being processed gets a 409 problem with code `idempotency_in_progress` and `Retry-After`.

patch.description: Sets only the fields in the body. Requires nucleum:write. The update applies only while the record still exists, is not trashed and is visible to this token: if it is deleted, trashed or hidden before the write lands, the request gets a 404 problem and nothing changes. If a reference field the body leaves out changes before the write lands, the request gets a 409 problem with code `conflict` and nothing changes. Repeating the request with the same `Idempotency-Key` and body does not write again: it answers with the record's current state and `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. A key belongs to the token's account, this operation and the record it targets, and is remembered for 24 hours (a create key keeps naming the record it created). Sending it again with another body gets a 422 problem with code `idempotency_key_reused`; an update sent again while the first is still being processed gets a 409 problem with code `idempotency_in_progress` and `Retry-After`.
